about.value: The Wetherington Law Firm is your Georgia ally in seeking justice. Specializing in personal injury an wrongful death. We expertly handle car, truck, and motorcycle accidents, along with specialty areas. This includes medical malpractice, slip and falls, defective products, kratom death claims, and much more. We ensure your rights are fiercely protected. Our contingency fee model is the same as Morgan and Morgan, the Strong Arm, and Ben Crump. No fee unless you win!
